about: Deterministic test vectors for zcrypto.mjs format version 1. All byte strings are lower-case hex. Regenerate with: node core/crypto-test.mjs --write-vectors
rng: Test-only randomness: call number c (from 0) of a generator with seed s returns n bytes, byte j = (s + 17c + j) mod 256. Each section names its seed.

room.rngCalls: room nonce (16), room key (32), history key (32), then one ephemeral X25519 key (32) per wrap
